subject: Next steps: lock 30-minute product intro + stakeholder options
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Eleanor Park <eleanor.park@hightide.io>, Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@hightide.io>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 17:15:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: lock 30-minute product intro + stakeholder options

Hi Eleanor / Samir —

Thanks again for the call today — good conversation and clear priorities. Quick synthesis and proposed next steps so we can get a 30-minute product intro locked on the calendar: 

Recap (2 bullets):
- Primary goal: validate Redwood’s inference economics and latency profile against Hightide’s batch scoring pipeline (peak windows + 99p latency target).
- Success criteria for the intro: short demo of inference routing + a brief Q&A on deployment modes (Hosted vs Dedicated) and a high-level cost estimate for your production profile.

Ask / next step: pick a 30-minute slot (we’ll include a short agenda + attendees) — I’m proposing three options below (all PT):

Option A: Tue Sep 2 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT
Option B: Wed Sep 3 — 2:00–2:30 PM PT
Option C: Thu Sep 4 — 11:30 AM–12:00 PM PT

Please reply with your preferred option and who from Hightide should join (we recommend a product lead + an SRE/infra person if you want to dig into latency/caching). If procurement or legal should be looped early, mention that and we’ll include a short pre-read.

Attachments: Redwood_PostDiscovery_Recap.pdf (short one-pager with the discovery notes + target success criteria).

If none of the three work, tell me two 30-minute windows that do and we’ll adapt. I’ll hold Option B tentatively until I hear from you.

Thanks — I’ll include Mina (AM) to coordinate the calendar and make sure the demo includes the right engineer.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147

Marcus —

Thanks for the recap and the clear options. Quick answers:

- Preference: Option B (Wed Sep 3, 2:00–2:30 PM PT) works best for the core group. Can you lock that?
- Our attendees: myself (Product), Samir (ML Lead) — I’m also adding Liam (SRE) and Aisha (Procurement) on CC so they’re visible. Liam wants to review any infra/latency pre-reads; Aisha will need the SOC2 / security summary for procurement intake.

One ask: can you attach the SOC2 summary or the security checklist ahead of the demo? I won’t expect legal to attend the 30-min session, but Aisha will need the doc to start procurement. Also, please include any notes on deployment options (VPC/on‑prem) since we’ll need that scoped quickly.

Thanks for tentatively holding Option B — lock it and share the calendar invite plus a one-page agenda.

Best,
Eleanor Park
Director of Product, Hightide Analytics
eleanor.park@hightide.io
